templates.title: Codex implementation brief
templates.reason: Concrete wording revised for outcome ownership, proportional rigor or reduced mandatory ceremony within this template’s purpose.

changes.before: make the smallest coherent implementation, and report tests actually run plus remaining limitations
changes.after: deliver a complete coherent implementation, and report verification actually performed plus remaining limitations

changes.before: Identify decisions that require clarification instead of guessing.
changes.after: Carry the authorized work through the requested outcome and proportionate validation; investigation, a plan, a first passing test, or an intermediate checkpoint is not completion. Keep complexity and verification proportional to the change, without treating brevity or a small diff as permission to omit needed behavior. Resolve routine choices from repository context; clarify only decisions whose missing facts materially affect correctness, scope, or authorization.

templates.title: Debugging investigation
templates.reason: Concrete wording revised for outcome ownership, proportional rigor or reduced mandatory ceremony within this template’s purpose.

changes.after: Investigate {{failure_summary}} using the evidence and authorized tools available.

changes.before: For each hypothesis, specify the smallest discriminating test, what each result would mean, and the next branch to follow.
changes.after: Use discriminating checks to test the leading hypotheses, explain what each observed result means, and follow the evidence until the cause or a precise blocker is established. If tools or sources are unavailable, provide the next concrete diagnostic step and clearly distinguish it from work performed.

changes.before: Finish with regression tests and evidence required to call the problem resolved.
changes.after: If repair is within the stated authorization, carry it through and verify the affected behavior. Choose regression coverage proportional to the failure and the risk of recurrence; tests alone do not establish product quality. Otherwise report the supported diagnosis and recommended remedy without claiming a repair.
